items.markdown:
![20-Minute Pad Kra Pao (Thai Basil Pork) - Cooking Therapy](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280406-1672-0139-0000-9689213ee4f1:6)
Pad kra pao requires `fresh holy basil, ground meat, and bird's eye chilies` . Here is the complete list of ingredients needed to make this classic Thai stir-fry.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/pad-kra-pao-beef/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/pad-kra-pao-beef/)[[2]](https://www.tiktok.com/@scrannaasty/video/7665349627947863318)

Main Ingredients

- **Meat:** 350g to 500g of ground pork, chicken, or beef (minced texture works best).
- **Basil:** 1 to 2 cups of fresh Thai holy basil leaves (*kra pao*).
- **Aromatics:** 5 to 6 cloves of garlic and 3 to 6 Thai bird's eye chilies (adjust to your spice level).
- **Optional Veggies:** Small handful of chopped long beans or green beans and diced shallots.
- **Cooking Oil:** 2 tablespoons of a neutral oil like vegetable or canola oil.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/pad-kra-pao-beef/) [[1]](https://www.deanedwards.co.uk/blog/fakeaway-series/pad-kra-pao-thai-pork-and-basil/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DPeTY_AESrz/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.iankewks.com/pad-kra-pao-thai-holy-basil-stir-fry/)[[4]](https://rosasthai.com/recipes/stir-fried-holy-basil)[[5]](https://www.cooking-therapy.com/pad-kra-pao/)[[6]](https://www.notquitenigella.com/2025/05/12/pad-kra-pao-recipe/)[[7]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-basil-chicken-recipe-pad-kra-pao-gai/)[[8]](https://www.foodandwine.com/pad-krapow-basil-stir-fry-7485308)

Sauce Ingredients

- **Fish Sauce:** 1 to 2 tablespoons.
- **Soy Sauce:** 1 tablespoon of light or regular soy sauce.
- **Oyster Sauce:** 1 tablespoon.
- **Dark Soy Sauce:** 1/2 to 1 teaspoon (used mostly for color and rich flavor).
- **Sugar:** 1 teaspoon of granulated sugar or palm sugar.
- **Water or Stock:** 2 to 3 tablespoons of water or chicken/beef broth to help blend the sauce.[](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-basil-chicken-recipe-pad-kra-pao-gai/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/pad-kra-pao-anything/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fYhTo_gb1G8&vl=en&t=45)

Serving Essentials

- **Rice:** Steamed jasmine rice.
- **Egg:** 1 crispy fried egg (*kai dao* ) per plate to top the dish.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/pad-kra-pao-beef/)
